    Package index

    Data model

    A casualty is a patient card; an ordered set of them is a cohort; a cohort plus board capacities is a scenario. Validation is vectorised over the cohort, so a bad import names every offending row and column at once.

    sdt_patient_card()
    Create a patient card
    validate_patient_card()
    Validate a patient card
    format(<patient_card>)
    Format a patient card
    sdt_cohort()
    Build a validated casualty cohort
    validate_cohort()
    Validate a casualty cohort
    sdt_as_patient_cards()
    Explode a cohort into patient cards
    sdt_scenario()
    Build a mass-casualty scenario
    as_tibble(<scenario>)
    Coerce a scenario to a tibble
    autoplot(<scenario>)
    Plot a scenario
    sdt_triage_levels() sdt_therapy_levels() sdt_diagnostics() sdt_board_areas() sdt_life_range() sdt_injury_regions() sdt_sex_levels()
    Controlled vocabularies for the mass-casualty domain

    Reference distributions

    The published marginals the package calibrates against, kept apart from sandtablR’s own modelling choices so a calibration test cannot quietly check the model against its own assumptions.

    sdt_reference()
    Reference distributions for the mass-casualty domain
    sdt_reference_scenario()
    The scenario the engine is calibrated on
    sdt_reference_horizon()
    The horizon the engine is calibrated on

    Synthetic data

    Generate a cohort from marginals, or synthesise a releasable replica of a real one.

    sdt_synthetic_cohort()
    Generate a synthetic mass-casualty cohort
    sdt_synthesise()
    Synthesise a releasable replica of a real cohort
    sdt_synthesis_utility()
    Score a synthetic replica against its seed cohort
    sdt_add_decisions()
    Add participant decisions to a cohort

    Simulation

    A discrete-event model of the board. The event log it records, not the summary, is what everything downstream is built on.

    sdt_simulate()
    Run a mass-casualty patient-flow simulation
    summary(<game_run>)
    End-of-game location distribution

    Decision paths

    Casualty pathways as state sequences: their shape, their groupings, and how repeatably the same casualty is handled.

    sdt_decision_paths()
    Build decision paths from a game run
    sdt_decision_consistency()
    Score decision consistency
    sdt_seqdef()
    Build a TraMineR state-sequence object
    sdt_seq_cluster()
    Cluster decision paths

    Machine learning

    One interface over interpretable and black-box engines, scored on the same held-out split.

    sdt_fit()
    Fit a triage or therapy classification model
    sdt_workflowset()
    Screen every engine on one cohort
    sdt_engines()
    Model engines available to the workbench
    sdt_transformer()
    A tabular transformer specification
    sdt_metric_set()
    The metric set the workbench scores on
    sdt_metrics()
    Metrics for a fitted model
    sdt_predictions()
    Held-out predictions from a fitted model
    predict(<sdt_model>)
    Predict from a fitted mass-casualty model
    sdt_consistency_score()
    Agreement between two labellings of the same casualties
